about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Ohio Environmental Protection Agency
channels.legal_basis: Ohio NPDES permit standard conditions (40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)): noncompliance, including a sanitary sewer overflow or bypass, reported to Ohio EPA within 24 hours, with Ohio EPA's 5-day SSO follow-up form
channels.note: No web page: every Ohio permittee reports a sewer overflow or bypass to Ohio EPA within 24 hours by e-mail or phone and files a 5-day follow-up for an SSO; annual SSO reports go into STREAMS (search only). None of these reports is published, and Ohio files nothing to EPA's sewer overflow tables (0 Ohio rows on 2026-11-03). Covers every Ohio operator in data/dischargers.json. (oh-epa-noncompliance-sso-notification)

channels.name: Ohio Environmental Protection Agency, Office of Emergency Response
channels.note: Ohio EPA's open spills layer: every incident called in to the emergency response line since 2017, updated daily, with the spill's day, the report time, a point and the product (873 human sewage and sewage sludge cases on 2026-11-08). No operator, no start time, no end. Read daily by the feed. (oh-epa-spills-opendata)
